reason: A offers the more specific and physically plausible mechanism—Cu surface segregation followed by surface-localized premelting—with a directly observable sequence and a composition-based falsification test, and it has relevant though imperfect supporting evidence. B is broader and more confounded because cooling rate may alter size, phase state, and defects as well as chemical uniformity, while its claim that uniformity necessarily raises and sharpens melting is insufficiently grounded.
